outcome: demographic and clinical characteristics of infants with CMT
cohort: 111 infants aged 0 to 5 months diagnosed with and undergoing treatment for CMT
finding: Children born via vaginal delivery had left-sided torticollis with a more significant broadening of the SCM, as shown on ultrasound scans, than right-sided torticollis.
